# Image blob ids the public mirror's history leaves out: every render that
# had been replaced or deleted by the first publishes (fixed at b9048c8, the
# P1 commit, 2026-10-01). tools/release/export_public.sh strips exactly these.
#
# The list is frozen on purpose. Computing it afresh from each export's tree
# rewrote old commits whenever a render was superseded later -- the P2 export
# was refused as a non-fast-forward after two goldens were recaptured. So
# renders superseded from here on stay in the public history, which is
# append-only. Adding ids here rewrites published history, which needs a
# forced push, which breaks every clone: the user's call, not a routine edit.
